newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Assailants target Rabin assassin's family.
newsitem.headline: Assailants target Rabin assassin's family.

text.p: Unknown assailants hurled overnight a fire bomb at a kindergarten where the mother of Yitzhak Rabin's assassin Yigal Amir works in Tel Aviv but no one was hurt, police said on Monday.
A police spokeswoman said the fire bomb attack caused severe material damage to the building.

The spokeswoman said an anonymous caller told the Tel Aviv police the attack was intended at the home of Yigal Amir, located near the kindergarten, and that the assailants accomplished their mission safely.
Amir is serving a life sentence for killing Rabin at a peace rally last November over the prime minister's acceptance to trade Israeli-occupied land for peace with the Palestinians.
